data: Repeat the independent 64-byte, eight-line block from messdaten.tide. For each late error replace the digit 0 in the penultimate row with x without changing file size.
measurement: Fresh process to JSON output, warm tmpfs inputs, zsh time %*E (wall seconds to 1 ms) and %M (wait4 process peak RSS in KiB). Build and data generation excluded.
rounds: One warmup per arm and size, then eight pairs per size, alternating arm order. Check every result. Median across eight, paired speed ratios.
